metadata.derived_from_nfr_statement: Calls to downstream systems SHALL be wrapped in a circuit breaker with exponential-backoff retry; the system SHALL degrade gracefully and surface a typed error to the caller rather than propagating the underlying failure.

scenarios.title: Downstream-call resilience (circuit breaker + retry) — downstream healthy / idempotent retry / primary region
scenarios.description: Verify Downstream-call resilience (circuit breaker + retry) under variation: load=downstream healthy, payload=idempotent retry, env=primary region. NFR statement: Calls to downstream systems SHALL be wrapped in a circuit breaker with exponential-backoff retry; the system SHALL degra

expected_outputs.summary: the breaker opens after threshold and a typed error is returned to the caller
